controlledCarry.scope: Private source programs, two controlled day-two victories and native persistent variables on entry to three scenarios; no original quest/victory validation

transitions.description:
Fire and Smoke, peal of swords and whistle of arrows...
Many years have passed since those glorious battles.
Life is more or less peaceful now. All clans and groups licked their wounds.
But what is a life without fighting!?
transitions.name: In the Wake of Gods
transitions.scenarioDescription: Duel XL contre lu2019ordinateur. Chaque royaume dispose de vingt-neuf repaires WoG, avec leurs gardiens et ru00e9compenses du2019origine, et du2019une Grotte mystu00e9rieuse proposant de vrais choix. Des forts permettent de payer les amu00e9liorations de vos cru00e9atures, notamment la chau00eene des dragons de cristal. Deux repaires flottants demandent de voler : des Ailes du2019ange gardu00e9es par vingt Griffons royaux attendent chaque royaume. Trente-trois lieux de recrutement par royaume ouvrent de nouvelles familles et leurs u00e9volutions. Cinq autres sites peuvent se transformer au premier jour selon les probabilitu00e9s WoG. Explorez, pru00e9parez votre armu00e9e puis choisissez les combats. Victoire : vaincre votre adversaire.

transitions.scenarioDescription:
You stand agape listening for all those stories about glorious campaign that Gorynych took place.
All of a sudden Gorynych stops rooted to the ground.
"What's... wrong?", you ask.
Gorynych smells the air and wrinkle his nose:
"Well, I think we arrived."

bonuses.description: Start with 4 Sulfur, Mercury, Crystal, and Gems

transitions.scenarioDescription:
The journey here was long.
Gorynych nagged you the entire time in a tiresome voice:
"How would you make it without me!?"
Your blind belief Gorynych's divine destiny is starting to fade.
All the while, your new companion, Monk, kept his silence.
You are unsure that you choose the right way.
